Versions

Vector: 2.0.4
DataEast: 2.0.2

What's Changed

  • Added Switch Health for Data East by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/439
  • Decay format bug fixes by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/410
  • Wpc config tweaks by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/426
  • system 11 and system9 configs tweaks by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/428

Bug fixes

  • Various security upgrades / patches by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/434
  • Fix streamed USB API responses and the hang after a failed update by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/437

Development

  • Added classic boards to HIL testing by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/441

Full Changelog: https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/compare/1.12.20...2.0.4
